# 1. Setup
  
## - Setting work directories
  
Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}

```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}

```

## - Loading palettes

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load additional colour palette packages
library(unikn, quietly = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)
library(yarrr, quietly = TRUE)
library(scales, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggsci, quietly = TRUE)

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package
mix_1 <- usecol(pal = c(Karpfenblau, "white", Peach), n = 15)
mix_2 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_seeblau), "white", pal_pinky))
mix_3 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_bordeaux), "white", pal_petrol), n = 15)

# Display the custom palettes
seecol(list(mix_1, mix_2, mix_3), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 4, title = "Comparing palettes mixed from unikn colors", pal_names = c("mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"))

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages
brew_mix <- usecol(c(rev(brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Reds")), "white", brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Blues")), n = 13)
brew_ext <- usecol(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"), n = 12)
yarrr_mix <- usecol(c(piratepal("nemo"), piratepal("bugs")))
yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)

gradient_exp <- rev(c('#470A06', '#710D10', '#A21317', "#EB4E3B", "#FCAE91", brew_mix[6:7], '#F7F9FF', '#F4F7FF', '#f2f2f2'))

# Display the second set of custom palettes
seecol(pal = list(brew_mix, brew_ext, yarrr_mix, yarrr_mod), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 2, title = "Using usecol() and seecol() to mix and modify palettes", pal_names = c("brew_mix", "brew_ext", "yarrr_mix", "yarrr_mod"))

# Define additional custom palettes from the scales package
natjournals_palette <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)
```

# 3. Abundance Analysis

## - BM MNCs

```{r}
set.seed(123)
SCE_Merged <- SingleCellExperiment(assays=list(counts=Merged.SeuratObj@assays$SCT@counts, 
                                               logcounts=Merged.SeuratObj@assays$SCT@data),
                                   colData=Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data,
                                   reducedDims=SimpleList(PCA=Merged.SeuratObj@reductions$harmony@cell.embeddings, UMAP=Merged.SeuratObj@reductions$h_umap@cell.embeddings))

Merged_Milo <- Milo(SCE_Merged)
Merged_Milo
```

```{r}
Merged_Milo <- buildGraph(Merged_Milo, k = 20, d = 11, reduced.dim = "PCA")
```

```{r}
Merged_Milo <- makeNhoods(Merged_Milo, prop = 0.11, k = 20, d = 11, refined = TRUE, reduced_dims = "PCA")
```

```{r}
plotNhoodSizeHist(Merged_Milo)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Merged_Milo <- countCells(Merged_Milo, meta.data = as.data.frame(colData(Merged_Milo)), sample="Donor_timepoint")
Merged_Milo <- calcNhoodDistance(Merged_Milo, d=11, reduced.dim = "PCA")
```

```{r}
Merged_Design <- data.frame(colData(Merged_Milo))[,c("Donor","Timepoint","Donor_timepoint")]

## Convert batch info from integer to factor
Merged_Design$Donor_timepoint <- as.factor(Merged_Design$Donor_timepoint)
Merged_Design$Timepoint <- as.factor(Merged_Design$Timepoint)
Merged_Design <- distinct(Merged_Design)
rownames(Merged_Design) <- Merged_Design$Donor_timepoint

Merged_Design
```

```{r}
da_results <- testNhoods(Merged_Milo, design = ~ Timepoint, design.df = Merged_Design, reduced.dim='PCA', fdr.weighting="graph-overlap")
```

```{r}
da_results <- annotateNhoods(Merged_Milo,
                                 da_results,
                                 coldata_col="Celltype")
```

```{r}
da_results$Celltype <- factor(da_results$Celltype, 
                                    levels=rev(cols <- c(
  "Naive B-cells",
  "Transitional B-cells",
  "Atypical memory B-cells",
  "IgM memory B-cells",
  "Class switched memory B-cells",
  "CD4+ T-cells",
  "CD8+ T-cells",
  "NK cells",
  "CD14+ monocytes",
  "CD16+ monocytes",
  "Dendritic cells"
)))
```

```{r}
da.res <- da_results
group.by <- "Celltype"

# robust group column (avoid data.frame inside a column)
da.res <- da.res %>%
  mutate(group_by = .data[[group.by]]) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group_by))

# --- Rank groups by (#pos - #neg) among significant nhoods (SpatialFDR < 0.1) ---
alpha <- 0.10

sig_counts <- da.res %>%
  filter(!is.na(SpatialFDR), SpatialFDR < alpha, !is.na(logFC)) %>%
  group_by(group_by) %>%
  summarise(
    pos   = sum(logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    neg   = sum(logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero  = sum(logFC == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(diff = pos - neg)

# ensure ALL groups are present (even if no significant nhoods)
group_levels_all <- da.res %>% distinct(group_by)
rank_table <- group_levels_all %>%
  left_join(sig_counts, by = "group_by") %>%
  mutate(across(c(pos, neg, zero, n_sig, diff), ~ tidyr::replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  arrange(desc(diff), desc(n_sig), group_by)

# Use this new order for plotting
ordered_levels <- rev(rank_table$group_by)
da.res <- da.res %>%
  mutate(
    group_by = factor(group_by, levels = ordered_levels, ordered = TRUE),
    is_expanded = SpatialFDR < alpha,
    logFC_color = ifelse(is_expanded, logFC, NA_real_)
  )

# --- Plot (no manual pos_x/pos_y; discrete axis controls the order) ---
Merged_Plot <-
  ggplot(
    da.res %>% arrange(group_by),
    aes(x = group_by, y = logFC, color = logFC_color)
  ) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(size = 0.7) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = ordered_levels, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = rev(c(
      '#590d22','#a4133c','#BC162E','#ff8fa3',
      '#90e0ef','#00b4d8','#0077b6','#01145e'
    )),
    na.value = "grey80"
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 22) +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  ylab(expression(paste("Log Fold Change"))) + xlab('')

# --- Save ---
dir.create(file.path(output_folder, "Phenotype"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
png(
  filename = file.path(output_folder, "Phenotype", "Milo_Timepoints_Celltype.png"),
  width = 6 * 0.55, height = 10 * 0.55, res = 110, units = "in", type = "cairo"
)
print(Merged_Plot)
dev.off()

# Expose ranking as before
avg_rank_by_group <- rank_table
avg_rank_by_group

digest::digest(da.res)
#6a77226c15d2d1aa1ab06a12befa9b58
```
